tools.name: HANDOVER
tools.line: Switch AI. Keep everything it knew.
tools.text: HANDOVER maps your folders in your browser and builds one pack your next AI loads on day one, so moving to a new provider doesn't mean starting from scratch. Nothing is uploaded.

tiers.text: Map your folders and see what goes into the pack.

tiers.label: Paid · $99, one payment
tiers.text: The full pack, ready for your next AI to load.
